codeReview.summary: The fix correctly addresses the gocritic/hugeParam finding by changing GetKernelRepoEnablements to take *System and updating all in-repo call sites. The install-stage orchestration remains generic and data-driven, and the existing test coverage for repo-enable behavior was updated consistently.

issues.description: GetKernelRepoEnablements now accepts *System but dereferences s without a nil guard. Current call sites pass non-nil pointers, but a nil input from future/external callers would panic.
